definition: an icon or figure representing a person in a game or online
hook: Before it was a profile picture, an avatar was a god coming down to Earth.
modernAnchor: A cartoon face. A game character. A tiny picture next to your name. We call it an avatar.
journey: Sanskrit avatara joined ava, down, with tara, crossing. It meant a coming down.
In Hindu belief, the god Vishnu descends into the world in bodily form to set things right. Each descent is an avatara.
English picked the word up in the 1700s, still tied to gods taking on flesh.
Then computing borrowed it. A person stepping into a digital world in a borrowed body was a descent all over again.
